messages.content: Give me the MTBI of my friend.

function.name: personality_assessment_evaluate
function.description: Evaluate and categorize a user's personality type based on a given array of personality trait percentages. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

percentage.description: The percentage representation of the trait in the user's personality.

detailed_output.description: Determines whether the output should include a detailed explanation of the personality type. This is optional.

message.content: I’m happy to help you figure out your friend’s MBTI type, but I’ll need some information first. Could you provide the percentages for each personality trait (e.g., Extraversion vs. Introversion, Sensing vs. Intuition, Thinking vs. Feeling, Judging vs. Perceiving)? Once I have those, I can run the assessment and give you the result.
message.reasoning: The user asks: "Give me the MBTI of my friend." They want an MBTI type. We have a tool to evaluate personality traits percentages. But we don't have the traits data. The user didn't provide any trait percentages. According to policy, we cannot guess or fabricate. We must ask for more info. We can say we need trait percentages. Also we can mention we can't determine MBTI without data. So we should respond asking for trait percentages.
